text: The paper reports that across all settings the method outperforms the baselines, often by a large gap, e.g. 85.4 F1 vs. at most 65.2 for baselines with ChatGPT on PopQA and 77.2 F1 vs. at most 60.1 for GPT-3 on TriviaQA. The most substantial gains are in recall, and ChatGPT generally outperforms GPT-3.
title: Cross-examination beats baselines, mainly in recall
